results.title: Indagine urbinate: "Così l'algoritmo influenza il voto"
results.snippet: An investigative news article highlighting Professor Fabio Giglietto's research at the University of Urbino, which revealed that Meta's algorithms reduced the visibility of official Italian political accounts by 72% while inadvertently boosting extremist content. The study triggered a formal inquiry in the European Parliament.

results.title: Algoritmi e democrazia, il caso Meta secondo lo studio di UniUrb
results.snippet: Media coverage of Giglietto's research on Meta's Political Content Reduction Policy. The piece highlights how his findings were featured on the national investigative television program 'Report' (Rai3) and served as the baseline for a European Parliament interrogation regarding platform threats to democracy.

results.title: Algoritmi e democrazia: il caso Meta secondo lo studio Uniurb che ha avviato un'interrogazione al Parlamento europeo
results.snippet: Press coverage from the University of Urbino detailing Giglietto's study on Meta's algorithmic reach reduction, outlining the European Commission's subsequent investigation into Meta's systemic risk mitigations under the Digital Services Act.

results.title: FG's Research Radio: Beyond the Loud CEOs: Inside Silicon Valley's Quiet AI Futures
results.snippet: An episode of the ongoing 'FG's Research Radio' podcast, hosted and curated by Fabio Giglietto. The podcast uses AI-driven text-to-speech technologies to break down complex academic research papers in computational social science and artificial intelligence for a broader public audience.
